about: One batch. u1 (count line to idea-mara) is approved on round 0. u2 (swim line to idea-tobias) gets a fix on rounds 0, 1 and 2, so it is undone after round 2; its copy leaves idea-tobias. The record asks a question about the haunted line. Round 0's findings list the post line as missed (a comment asked for it). The migrator's notes also changed a line in idea-mara that no record explains; the Edit guard flags it, the migration-verifier judges it not asked for, `act` puts it back, and the second check gives []. The log has, in order: Questions for you (the line quoted, the question, the answer line), Migrated, Units undone (the swim line quoted, its destination, 'the migration-verifier still found problems after 2 fix rounds:' and round 2's problem as '{check}: {what}', then 'The next migration run tries this again.'), Lines the checker says were missed (quoted, the migration-verifier's words, then 'The next migration run tries this again.'), Changes put back (the removed text quoted). It doesn't open with 'Nothing needs you.', since there is a question. The handled list: u1's source line with its pointer and its copy, and the question's line as `left in place`. The missed post line stays off, and so does the comment, since its piece holds an undone unit's source line and a missed line; nothing of u2 goes on.
spec: CONTRACT.md 5.6 items 1, 3 (left in place, a missed line never goes on, comment, never: undone units), 6
spec-run-manager.md 05 item 7; 07.1 items 6, 7, 9; 07.3 item 2; 11 Decisions Log item 81
readings: New handled entries follow the ones already there, sorted by note path (as Python sorts strings, so 'Ideas/…' comes before 'brain-dump.md'), then by their place in the note at close. Neither spec nor contract fixes the order, and run-state.json is compared as parsed JSON, so list order counts.
A handled entry's `pointer` lists every destination on the line at close, as paths inside the project.

A question's source line goes on the handled list as `left in place` (CONTRACT.md 5.6 item 3), but the log lists it under Questions for you, not under Left in place, and why, which comes from the record's left_in_place only (spec-migrator.md 06.2). A missed line stays off the handled list (spec-run-manager.md 11 Decisions Log item 81).
Units undone quotes only the last round's problems (round 2), as '{check}: {what}'.
An undone unit's source line isn't also listed under Other notes as a line the run did nothing with: an undone unit names it.
